name: CANONSHEEP_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 0: anim OPEN if not loaded, releases the Wolf and camera; Update: aims the dummy, fires (10) when the Wolf is in detectBox (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_WOLF_INSIDE
meaning: SetState 1: freezes the Wolf (msg 0xe) and hides him; Update: camera on the barrel, player fires (8) or ... (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_FIRE
meaning: SetState 2: rumble, MSG_CB_SET_LETHAL to the ball and launch at the Wolf; Update: -> 0 (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_LOAD1
meaning: SetState 3: anim LOAD1, Wolf visible again; Update: on anim end -> 4 (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_LOAD2
meaning: SetState 4: anim LOAD2; Update: on anim end -> 5 (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_CLOSE
meaning: SetState 5: anim CLOSE; Update: on anim end loaded = 1, -> 0 (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_CINEMATIC
meaning: SetState 8: StartCine(cine, cineFlag, cineText); Update: -> 0 when the cinematic finishes (inferred)

name: CANONSHEEP_ST_AIM
meaning: SetState 10: dummy shown, MSG_CB_PLACE to the ball, aimTimeMs 400; Update: tracks the Wolf, then 2 (inferred)
